address: 51 Old Airport Road Food Centre, #01-135/136, 51 Old Airport Road, 390051, Singapore
bio: This kway chap stall serves the broad rice noodles with pork belly, trotters, intestine, tripe and dried tofu braised in a spiced soy-based marinade. Noodles are thin and silky; braised pork and tofu impart deep flavours and aromas....
